responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend wrapper for GCC garbage-collected interned identifiers. The header defines Rust::GGC::Ident as a lightweight owner of a GCC tree identifier node, exposing construction from C strings or std::string, equality against another Ident or a string, and accessors for IDENTIFIER_POINTER, IDENTIFIER_LENGTH, and the underlying tree; it provides the public utility interface used where Rust code needs stable canonical identifier storage compatible with GCC’s GGC-managed stringpool.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface header for the rust-ggc pair: unlike rust-ggc.cc, it declares the GGC::Ident wrapper type and its inline accessors/operators, exposing the tree-backed identifier API to other Rust frontend code without containing the stringpool-call implementations.
